title: dryopteris aculeata var. muricata
intro: Dryopteris aculeata var. muricata, commonly known as the spiny wood fern, is a plant species belonging to the Dryopteris genus of ferns. It is a type of medicinal fern that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The spiny wood fern is used to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, making it a valuable herb in folk medicine due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of the spiny wood fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
